purpose: Test whether gripper-position and axis losses improve the existing motor map at unchanged refusal limits, without more physical demonstrations or changes to the observer/controller.
baseline: Preserve every V1/V2 checkpoint and report, the composed dinner workflow and the selected submission baseline.
observer: Frozen V4 observer, rigid keypoint fit and OpenVINO export from models/bottle_servo_v1.
controller: Unchanged V2 R1 routing, per-leg initial-image frozen ablation and the original physical monitor limits.

motor_training.loss: Mean squared Cartesian position residual divided by 5 mm, plus local-Y-up axis residual divided by 0.05, plus 0.01 times normalized joint-reference MSE. Differentiable FK is training-only and must match independent MuJoCo FK and finite-difference gradients.
motor_training.selection: Most accepted original kinematic development points, then lowest p95 position error. Select once before new physical development; no physical test outcome selects a checkpoint.

kinematic_gate: At least 360/362 accepted original kinematic development points and at most 0.5 mm p95 position error before physical development. This exposed kinematic set does not establish physical success.
development_gate: At least 4/6 nominal live and 4/6 pushed live before exposing final scenes; all four conditions and refusals retained. Otherwise stop with final seeds unexposed.
promotion_gate: At least 8/12 nominal live and 8/12 pushed live, plus a live advantage among at least four seeds where both nominal conditions pass. Otherwise keep experimental.
scope: A kinematic improvement is not a physical success. No runtime inverse solver, simulator object-state input, action retrieval, hidden force, relaxed guard or changed final seed is allowed. V1/V2 and composed-workflow final scenes stay excluded from selection.
